BackstoryDef.title: shrine officiant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] conducted ceremonies and organized offerings at a local shrine, listened to the requests of villagers and learned the customs and history of the shrine. When festivals approached, [PAWN_pronoun] helped organize the people preparing them.

BackstoryDef.title: shrine ritual attendant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served at a shrine, dancing kagura during festivals, preparing offerings and helping visitors. Repeated performance honed [PAWN_possessive] agility, while welcoming worshippers taught [PAWN_objective] to deal with unfamiliar people.

BackstoryDef.title: itinerant ritualist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] traveled between villages and markets, performing rites and purification ceremonies at the request of local people. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to speak with strangers and adapt to the customs of each community.

BackstoryDef.title: itinerant woodturner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] traveled through the mountains in search of suitable timber, making wooden bowls, ladles and other utensils. [PAWN_pronoun] knew how to judge a tree and kept making tools while moving from place to place.

BackstoryDef.title: hunter's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a family that lived by hunting, learning to recognize animal tracks and paths through the woods. [PAWN_pronoun] helped repair traps and carry game, and gradually learned to use a bow.

BackstoryDef.title: falconer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to capture and train hawks to pursue prey. Watching the birds' condition and movements, [PAWN_pronoun] practiced their handling and was entrusted with preparations and care for falconry.

BackstoryDef.title: traveling artisan's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a family of artisans who carried their tools from place to place, helping with work wherever the family stopped. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to handle materials and tools and grew accustomed to dealing with customers and local people on the road.

BackstoryDef.title: textile weaver
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent many years spinning thread and weaving cloth on a loom. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to judge thread tension, spot irregularities in the weave, and maintain the tools used in the work.

BackstoryDef.title: potter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to select clay, shape vessels and fire them while carefully tending the kiln. Making everyday jars and storage pots taught [PAWN_objective] how different clays behaved and how to control the firing process.

BackstoryDef.title: coastal fisher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made a living fishing in a coastal village, watching the tides and finding the places where fish gathered. [PAWN_pronoun] caught fish using hooks and nets, kept fishing gear in good repair, and helped carry the catch ashore.

BackstoryDef.title: coastal salt maker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked on the coast, concentrating seawater and boiling down brine in a cauldron to make salt. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to plan coastal work around the weather, tend the fuel supply and control the heat.

BackstoryDef.title: fishing village childhood
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a coastal settlement, helping [PAWN_possessive] family with fishing and learning the tides and seasonal movements of fish. [PAWN_pronoun] also helped maintain nets and fishing tackle and carry the catch ashore.

BackstoryDef.title: weaver's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a household that wove cloth, helping wind yarn and keep threads properly tensioned. Watching the loom at work, [PAWN_pronoun] learned simple weaving tasks and how to handle the tools with care.

BackstoryDef.title: woodcutter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked in the mountains, selecting trees suitable for timber, felling them and hauling the logs out of the woods. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to judge slopes and the direction of a falling tree, working with others to bring the logs down from the mountains.
